takes.title: Bring the Hands Together for a Handshake Mime
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with arms extended sideways, brings the hands together in front for a compact repeated motion, and lowers them to stand.

takes.title: Mime Chopping with Repeated Compact Hand Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands close together near the torso and repeats small downward motions while standing. They lower the arms at the end.

takes.title: Raise Both Hands in Front and Turn Aside
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both forearms into a compact chest-height pose, turns sideways while opening a hand, and relaxes the arms.

takes.title: Mime Sewing with a Hand Lift toward the Face
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, makes repeated small two-handed motions, raises a hand toward the face, and lowers both arms to finish.

takes.title: Mime Digging with Compact Arm Movements
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly draws an elbow back and brings both hands together near the waist before returning to an upright pose with arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime Paying with Both Hands in Front
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands near the chest, holds them forward with small repeated adjustments, and lowers them to finish. The source describes paying.

takes.title: Mime Hanging a Picture with High Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly raises both hands near or above the face, dips them toward the waist, and returns to a high reach before lowering the arms.

takes.title: Bend to Pick Up an Object and Extend It Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends toward the floor, straightens while drawing the arms in, and extends both forearms before standing with arms low.

takes.title: Mime Planting with Repeated Floor Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands, turns, folds forward deeply, and repeatedly adjusts the hands near the floor before standing again.

takes.title: Mime Boxing with Alternating Arm Extensions
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both arms and repeatedly extends one across or in front of the body while shifting their stance. They lower the arms to finish.

takes.title: Mime Pulling a Sweater On
takes.actionDescription: The performer gathers both hands near the chest, lifts them over the head, and lowers an arm toward the waist before standing relaxed.

takes.title: Mime Fishing with a Larger Opening Sweep
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans back and raises an arm, then repeats shorter arm motions near the chest. They finish upright with both arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime Drumming with Short Alternating Strokes
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both hands in front, alternates short motions near the chest and face, and turns to extend both arms before lowering them.

takes.title: Gesture as if Teaching, Then Lower the Hand
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a hand near the face and extends it diagonally outward several times while shifting weight. The take ends upright.

takes.title: Mime Putting On a Coat and Adjusting It
takes.actionDescription: The performer gathers the arms, lifts them behind or above the head, extends an arm to the side, then brings the hands toward the front of the torso.

takes.title: Mime Stirring Batter with Hands Close Together
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts both forearms and repeatedly moves one hand across the other near the torso. They lower both arms to finish.

takes.title: Mime Working Dough with Both Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps both hands close together at mid-torso, making repeated small motions while occasionally shifting stance. They end with arms down.

takes.title: Mime Vacuuming with Forward Presses and a Turn
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings the hands forward, leans into repeated arm extensions while turning into profile, then returns to standing.

takes.title: Mime Pushing a Broom from Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer gathers their hands, turns into profile, and leans forward through low arm strokes before straightening.

takes.title: Mime Planting with Repeated Hand Adjustments
takes.actionDescription: The performer briefly extends a hand forward, then repeats smaller motions with both hands near the chest. They finish with arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime Pushing a Swing with Both Arms Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer extends both forearms, retracts and repeats the motion from a slightly turned stance, then lowers the arms.

takes.title: Mime Putting On and Adjusting a Hat
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands to the head several times, briefly brings them nearer the face, and relaxes the arms after the final adjustment.

takes.title: Mime Adjusting a Skirt while Turning
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves both hands around waist height, alternating between front and side-facing poses before standing with arms down.

takes.title: Mime Eating with Repeated Hand-to-Mouth Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly moves a hand toward the mouth and back to the chest while standing, then lowers both arms.

takes.title: Mime Answering a Phone and Holding It to the Ear
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one hand to the side of the head, briefly lowers or extends it, then returns it near the ear before lowering the arm.

takes.title: Mime Dialing and Lifting a Phone
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes small motions with both hands near the chest, raises one hand to the side of the face, and lowers the arms to finish.

takes.title: Mime Handling a Glass and Taking a Sip
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves both hands forward at chest height, briefly lifts one hand toward the mouth, and returns to standing with arms down. The source identifies a glass of water.

takes.title: Alternate Hand-to-Mouth Gestures While Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates bringing a hand close to the face with outstretched and chest-level gestures, then lowers both arms. The source describes drinking and smoking.

takes.title: Mime Chugging with the Head Tipped Back
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly raises one hand toward the mouth, tips the head back in a larger motion, and lowers the hand to stand upright.

takes.title: Move the Head, Arms, and Legs through Range of Motion
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with small head and upper-body movements, opens the arms and extends a leg, then finishes with both arms horizontal.

takes.title: Mime Making Coffee with Small Hand Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts both hands near the chest, alternates short forward and inward motions, and returns to a relaxed standing stance.

takes.title: Mime Slicing with Repeated Short Strokes
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the hands close together in front and repeats short strokes with one hand. They lower both arms to finish.

takes.title: Mime Eating Soup with a Repeated Hand Lift
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings one hand toward the mouth several times while holding the other near the torso. Both hands lower at the end.

takes.title: Mime Raking with Weight Shifts and Forward Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates low reaches and brief straightening, shifting weight as the arms draw in. They finish standing.

takes.title: Mime Putting On Headphones and Lowering the Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the hands toward the sides of the head, makes several small adjustments, and lowers them before standing upright.

takes.title: Mime Playing a Violin with a Raised Arm
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings one hand near the shoulder and moves the other arm repeatedly in front of the chest, then lowers both arms.

takes.title: Mime Watching TV and Reaching Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats small gestures near the face and chest, extends one hand forward during a slight lean, and returns to standing with arms down.

takes.title: Mime Driving with Both Hands in Front
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts both hands in front and alternates their heights while turning slightly, then lowers the arms to finish.

takes.title: Hold Both Hands near the Face and Lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the hands together near the face, adds a slight lean and several small hand motions, then lowers both arms.
takes.reviewNote: The source is Unknown and the intended activity is unclear from the hand motions.

takes.title: Mime Drinking from a Bottle with the Head Tipped Back
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly raises one hand to the mouth, tips the head back more deeply once, and ends upright with the hands near the chest.

takes.title: Huddle with Crossed Arms and Lower Them
takes.actionDescription: The performer crosses both arms close to the chest and shifts their weight in small motions. They finish standing with the arms down.

takes.title: Mime Freezing with Hands Gathered at the Chest
takes.actionDescription: The performer draws both hands close, crosses and uncrosses the forearms several times, then lets the arms fall.

takes.title: Open the Arms briefly and Gather the Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts the elbows and opens the arms outward briefly, then brings the hands together near the chest and returns to standing.

takes.title: Mime Laughing with Compact Hand and Torso Shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts a hand toward the face, tips the torso slightly, and returns to an upright stance as both arms lower.

takes.title: Mime Crying with Small Hand-to-Face Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly raises the hands from chest to face level with a slight lean. They lower both arms and stand upright.

takes.title: Mime Crying with a Sustained Raised Hand
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one or both hands near the face, makes small head and hand adjustments, and lowers the arms before the end.

takes.title: Extend Both Arms at Chest Height and Reset
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats a two-arm forward extension, bringing the forearms back in near the chest between reaches. They finish with the arms down.
takes.reviewNote: The source is Unknown and the gesture does not establish a specific task.

takes.title: Gesture with Alternating Hands as if Arguing
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates open-handed gestures and raised forearms near the head, then returns to standing with both arms relaxed.

takes.title: Mime a Gorilla with Forward Bends and Low Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly tips forward and keeps the arms low or slightly bent, then straightens to finish.

takes.title: Mime Window Cleaning with Alternating High Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one or both hands, extends an arm outward in several sweeping motions, then lowers the hands and stands.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Elbows Raised at the Chest
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the elbows high with hands close to the chest, repeats compact wing-like motions, and lowers the arms.

takes.title: Mime a Dog with Low Bends and Hanging Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer draws the forearms close at first, then repeats forward bends with the arms hanging. They finish leaning forward.

takes.title: Mime an Elephant with Bent and Raised Arm Poses
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates forward bends and small hand motions near the torso before lifting one arm overhead and straightening.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Side Bends and a Raised Hand
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans to either side, alternates the elbows outward, and finishes with one hand near the head.

takes.title: Mime a Mouse with Hands Gathered near the Face
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands close to the mouth, repeats small head and elbow adjustments, and lowers the arms at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Chipmunk with Compact Hand Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates hands near the chest and near the mouth with small weight shifts, then returns upright with arms down.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Repeated Deep Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the hands near the face, folds deeply forward twice with an upright reset between, and stands at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Snake with Short Forward Hand Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates a forward reach with a bent elbow and hand pulled near the chest, then lowers both arms.

takes.title: Mime a Panther with Raised Hands and Short Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both forearms near the face, leans forward and to one side, and finishes standing with arms lowered.

takes.title: Tilt Side to Side and Bend Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short sideways torso leans, then folds forward more deeply and returns upright.
takes.reviewNote: The source is Unknown and no specific scenario is distinguishable.

takes.title: Mime Sweeping with Short Forward Arm Strokes
takes.actionDescription: The performer draws the hands together, turns partly into profile, and repeats short forward strokes. The final pose keeps the hands raised in front.

takes.title: Mime a Bird with Repeated Wing-Like Arm Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly spreads both arms, angles them higher or lower, and lowers them after the last wide reach.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Deep Forward Bobs
takes.actionDescription: The performer stays upright between several pronounced forward folds with elbows bent, then straightens and lowers the arms.

takes.title: Mime a Cat with Head-Level Hand Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward and raises a hand to the side of the head at intervals, then finishes with both hands lifted near the head.

takes.title: Mime a Fish with Small Reaches and Weight Shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the forearms close, shifts the feet and briefly lifts a foot between arm gestures, then returns to standing.

takes.title: Gather the Hands Low and Fold Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes small movements with hands low, leans forward and sideways, then straightens.
takes.reviewNote: The source is Unknown and the visible low hand movements do not identify an activity.

takes.title: Shift between Wide Stances with Hands Raised
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates wide foot placements, brings both hands near the face or chest, and lowers the arms before the last stance.
takes.reviewNote: The source is Unknown. The visible motion could fit several kinds of mime or drill.

takes.title: Alternate Outward Reaches and Hand-to-Face Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats a short forward arm reach, brings the hands near the face, and returns upright with arms lowered.
takes.reviewNote: The source is Unknown and a more specific action is unclear.

takes.title: Mime Painting with Alternating Low and High Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends low, straightens into several forward or upward arm sweeps, and repeats the low bend before standing.

takes.title: Mime Playing Piano with Small Alternating Hand Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes small alternating motions with hands in front, briefly reaches farther while leaning, and finishes standing.

takes.title: Mime Chopping Wood with High and Forward Arm Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands high, repeats larger arm motions across the front of the body, then settles with one hand raised near the head.

takes.title: Mime Swimming Strokes from Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates opening the arms, sweeping them forward, and lifting the elbows, then finishes with both forearms still bent.

takes.title: Reach Out for a Handshake Mime and Return Upright
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one hand and makes a few short forward gestures, briefly draws both hands together, then lowers them.
